::: {#def-rss}
#### Residual sum of squares

The **residual sum of squares** of a model with parameter vector $\vth$,
fitted to data,
is the sum of the squared [residuals](estimation.qmd#def-residual)
$\resid_i$ that the parameter values $\vth$ produce:

$$\text{RSS}(\vth) \eqdef \sumin \resid_i^2.$$
:::
